description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Videos' that manages video uploads, displays a list of videos with their details, and handles UI interactions such as uploading and refreshing the list. It interacts with an API service to fetch and upload videos.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches the list of videos from the API and updates the component state.

methods.name: onUpload
methods.description: Handles the video file upload process, updates the video list upon success, and manages error states.
